name: howto
title: Is the deal real? The five-minute check
sub: Works on any product, in any store, on any sale day
footer: Sources: FTC Guides Against Deceptive Pricing (16 CFR 233.1); Target, Walmart and Best Buy reference-price pages (Nov 2026); Consumers' Checkbook (Nov 13, 2025). Our synthesis.

items.head: Ignore the crossed-out price
items.body: “Was”, “reg” and “compare at” are each store's own rule, not proof anyone paid it.

items.head: Copy the full model number
items.body: Bundle codes, colours, refurbished units and store-only versions are different products.

items.head: Check three stores
items.body: The maker's store, one big-box store and one more. The real price is what they charge.

items.head: Look at the history
items.body: Google's price insights or a tracker: is today under the last 90 days' low, or just typical?

items.head: Read the fine print
items.body: Sign-in, card-only, Kohl's Cash, a bundle or a gift card is not the same as a lower price.

items.head: Buy where a later drop is paid back
items.body: Target to Dec 24, Best Buy on its own drops, Costco for 30 days. Walmart.com: buy at the low only.

name: stores
title: Six crossed-out prices, checked
sub: The reference price shown, what stores really charged, and our call (Nov 20, 2026)
footer: Sources: store pages and search results on Nov 20, 2026; Slickdeals threads 2025–2026; REDTIGER's buying guide (May 19, 2026). Our calls are judgment, not a promise.
